scoring_justification: The main outputs are final classification labels and lifetimes from full MD simulations; the checker cannot rerun the simulations so result-level comparison against hidden paper gold with tolerances is the strongest feasible tier.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold structure classifications and lifetime targets from the paper
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Table I for structures; text for lifetimes
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper: 400K->Ih, 500K->Dh, 600K->Ih; 600K lifetime ~80 ns (50-120 window), 550K >3 μs (≥3000 ns threshold)
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are directly from the paper's reported results

outputs.description: Classified final cluster morphology (Ih, Dh, or hybrid) for three growth conditions: (400 K, 7 ns), (500 K, 7 ns), (600 K, 7 ns).
Metastable lifetime in nanoseconds for the 146-atom m-Dh at 600 K and 550 K.

output_contract.notes: The exact lifetime thresholds and acceptable ranges are defined in the hidden grading spec; they are not disclosed to the agent.
